title: release train weekly prep notes - 2026-05-08
content:
Weekly release-train prep notes (personal scratchpad)
Date: 2026-05-08
Owner: Noah Kim
Context: prepping for Friday release-train sync (go/no-go). Small feature launch for streaming API improvements + deployment of q4 batching optimizer. This is my working list to cover in sync and capture follow-ups.

Current go/no-go stance: TENTATIVE GO (see blocking items). Recommendation: proceed with go if infra scaling test and canary metrics look stable by EOW.

Open blockers / risks
- Autoscale regression: one customer reported request queueing spike on dedicated pool (ENG-5123). Root cause suspected to be a race in autoscaler leash logic. Owner: Samir Patel. Status: in-progress. Mitigation: hold canary concurrency at -10% until patch applied.
- Canary failure rate: experimental canary in us-west shows 2.7% 5xx on long-context requests (tracking in REL-2026). Owner: Maya Singh. Action: confirm if this is model-serving (runtime) or networking. Need logs from edge -> runtime chain.
- Rollback playbook gaps: DBA migration checklist missing after last-minute schema tweak (related to PR #3456). Owner: Priya Kapoor. Action: add explicit downtime window and quick rollback SQL.
- Observability retention: short retention on request traces causing limited post-mortem data for rare failures (tagged as ops debt). Owner: Ethan Park. Notes: temporary extended retention for release window (48h) approved? need confirmation.

Pre-release checklist (things I will call out during sync)
- [ ] Infra smoke tests green on staging (owner: Olivia Martin) -> target: 2026-05-08 16:00 PT
- [ ] Canary traffic 5xx <= 1% over 2 hours (owner: Maya Singh) -> if >1% then hold
- [ ] Autoscaler patch deployed to dedicated pools (owner: Samir Patel) -> verify no queueing under 2x expected load
- [ ] DB migration dry-run completed on staging, rollback validated (owner: Priya Kapoor)
- [ ] Monitoring alerts and dashboards published + notify SRE rotation (owner: Ethan Park)
- [ ] Post-deploy smoke scripts added to runbooks and CI (owner: Noah Kim)
- [ ] Customer comms draft for known impact window (owner: Product Ops) -> link once ready

Canary plan (short)
- Phase 1: 1% traffic to new streaming handler, 30m observation window, health probes run per-second.
- Phase 2: if stable, increase to 10% for 1 hour, run long-context stress tests.
- Phase 3: 50% for 2 hours, then full rollout.
- Abort criteria: sustained 5xx > 1% OR p50 latency regressions > 30% OR queue growth > 20% for 15m.

Rollback steps (quick notes)
1) Pause new traffic routing (edge flag) -> Route back to previous model-serving variant.
2) Revert infra config (k8s rollout to previous revision) -> SRE runbook page id on Confluence.
3) If DB migration executed, run rollback SQL from dry-run order.
4) Notify customers and open postmortem channel (#release-postmortem).

Communications
- Pre-release email: product + cs + ops (template in Confluence). Need final time window and expected impact. Owner: Product Ops.
- Slack channel: #release-2026-05 (ensure pinned runbook + short status messages).

Action items for this week (my personal follow-ups)
- [ ] Coordinate with Samir to get autoscaler patch into canary cluster (due 2026-05-08 EOD)
- [ ] Add two extra metrics to streaming handler dashboard (kv cache hits, batch sizes) - quick PR to observability repo (due 2026-05-09)
- [ ] Validate rollback SQL with DB team (Priya) and add to runbook (due 2026-05-09)
- [ ] Run a rapid manual dry-run of the canary plan against staging (no traffic) and capture runbook notes (due 2026-05-08)

Questions to bring up in meeting
- Do we have SLO guardrails for this release tier? who signs off on risk (product vs infra)?
- Is extended trace retention (48h) approved by SRE/infra for the weekend?
- Any customers in the canary cohort that need manual notification?

Notes from previous sync (2026-05-01)
- Agreed to tighten canary abort thresholds after spike incident.
- Decided to temporarily cap concurrency for dedicated tier during spike windows.

Misc scratch notes
- Quick commands to run smoke test: ./scripts/release_smoke.sh --staging --full
- Log grep: kubectl logs -l app=streaming-handler | grep -i queue
- Useful PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3430 (batching tweak), /pull/3456 (DB change), /pull/3467 (observability)

Scribe for Friday sync: I'll take notes and update the runbook. If anything becomes blocking before sync ping me in DM.

-- Noah
summary: Personal prep notes for 2026-05-08 release-train sync: tentative GO, list of blockers, checklist with owners, canary plan, rollback steps, action items and questions for meeting.
